usage: The word '玻璃門' (bo1 lei4 mun4) is used as a noun to refer to a door made of glass.
'玻璃門' can be the subject or object in a sentence, such as 'The glass door is clean.' or 'I opened the glass door.'
It is common to use measure words like '扇' (sin3) when counting glass doors, e.g. 一扇玻璃門 (jat1 sin3 bo1 lei4 mun4).
'玻璃門' often appears in contexts related to buildings, homes, or shops to specify entrance or interior doors made of glass.
You can modify '玻璃門' with adjectives or descriptive phrases to specify type or condition, e.g. '透明玻璃門' (transparent glass door).
